visual.general_description: Single line chart of activated clotting time in seconds against time in minutes, with a shaded 300 to 400 s band and event arrows for boluses, infusion start and stop, and procedure end.
visual.detailed_description: Single line chart: a blue line connecting five red round points, with time in minutes on the x axis (ticks 0, 50, 100, 150) and ACT in seconds on the y axis (ticks 0 to 500 in steps of 100) A light gray horizontal band spans the plot between the 300 and 400 gridlines. The first point lies near the left axis at roughly the 100 to 200 level, the second point rises to just below the 500 level shortly afterward, the third point falls below the gray band at roughly the 250 to 300 level near the 50 to 60 minute mark, the fourth point is the highest, just above the 500 level, and the last point lies within the gray band toward the right near the 150 minute end. Five black upward arrows sit below the x axis with rotated labels: two arrows near the origin each labeled "12.5mg bolus", then arrows labeled "Infusion start", "Infusion stop" and "Procedure end" in left to right order.
